title: A generic stack with safe pop
summary: Use a type parameter for a reusable last-in-first-out container, returning nil when empty.
triggers: a reusable LIFO container must preserve element type and handle underflow
prompts: Implement a stack that works for integers and strings without type casts.
invariant: The last pushed element is the first one popped.
mantra: Parameterize the element; push at the end; pop safely.
pitfalls: popLast returns nil for an empty array; removeLast traps.
A mutating method requires a var stack binding.
